annotations.title: Personal plan for an Israeli life event

description: Builds the whole personal paperwork plan for one Israeli life event: a birth, pregnancy, marriage, divorce or separation, a child starting kindergarten or school, losing or leaving a job, starting a new job, release from the IDF, long reserve duty, retirement, a death in the family, caring for an elderly parent, moving home, renting or buying a flat, buying or selling a car, aliyah or returning to Israel, opening or closing a business, or hiring a first employee. The event can be given in free words (Hebrew or English). Returns every step across all bodies (Population Authority, National Insurance, Tax Authority, employer, municipality, banks, insurers, utilities) with its class (A = Nayeret prepares the letter and the person sends it, B = co-pilot: the person files on the official site, C = a licensed professional is needed, info), the deadline computed from the official rule with its source URL, dependencies, documents to prepare, the values to copy into the official form, and an .ics calendar with reminders. Same verified data as nayeret.ai/autopilot/. | תוכנית אישית לאירוע חיים: לידה, הריון, חתונה, גירושין, גן ובית ספר, פיטורים, עבודה חדשה, שחרור, מילואים, פרישה, פטירה, הורה מבוגר, מעבר דירה, שכירת או קניית דירה, רכב, עלייה, פתיחה או סגירה של עסק, עובד ראשון, עם מועדים ממקורות רשמיים וקובץ יומן. Stateless: arguments and results are never stored, logged or shared (nayeret.ai/developers/). Not legal or tax advice.

answers.description: Optional answers that shape the plan (anything missing takes the default). Per event: aliyah: status (oleh|returning|senior_returning), city, address, tenure (tenant|owner|family), employed (yes|no), license (yes|no); army-release: service_len (full|12plus|under12), next (work|study|search|other), job_start (YYYY-MM-DD), arnona_payer (yes|no), city, address; birth: place (hospital|home|abroad), name_given (yes|no), married (yes|no), mother_work (employee|self|none), leave_start (YYYY-MM-DD), extend_unpaid (yes|no|maybe), employer_name, partner_work (employee|self|none|na), daycare (yes|maybe|no), passport (yes|no); buy-home: home_type (single|replacement|additional), seller (second|contractor), mortgage (yes|no), live (yes|no), move_date (YYYY-MM-DD), from_city, to_city, old_tenure (tenant|owner|parents), old_address, new_address; car: role (buy|sell), counterpart (private|dealer), online (yes|no), badge (yes|no), kvish6 (yes|no|unknown), car_number; close-business: type (patur|murshe|company), had_employees (yes|no), assets (no|yes), premises (home|rented), city, premises_address, next (employee|none); death: relation (parent|spouse|other), deceased_name, spouse_alive (yes|no), kids_under18 (yes|no), had_allowance (yes|no|unknown), will (yes|no|unknown), home (family|empty|none), city, home_address, car (yes|no), mortgage (yes|no), worked (yes|no), carer (yes|no), firearm (yes|no), dispute (no|yes); divorce: stage (separated|divorced), kids (yes|no), kids_with (me|other|split|shared), housing (i_leave|i_stay|none), move_date (YYYY-MM-DD), arnona_mine (yes|no|unknown), from_city, to_city, old_address, new_address, employed (yes|no), name_back (yes|no|later), old_name, new_name; elderly-parent: lives_alone (yes|no), adl (yes|some|no), ltc (yes|no), old_age (yes|supplement|no), caregiver (foreign|israeli|company|unknown), hire_date (YYYY-MM-DD), car (yes|no), city, address; first-employee: biz (patur|murshe|company), emp_pension (yes|no|unknown), payroll (self|rep), business_name; job-loss: how (fired|resigned|ended), tenure (under1|1plus), work_months (under12|12|16|17|18), next_job (yes|no), unemployment (yes|no), group_health (yes|no|unknown), dispute (no|yes), employer_name, start_date (YYYY-MM-DD); marriage: where (religious|abroad), name (yes|no|later), old_name, new_name, employed (yes|no), prenup (yes|maybe|no); moving: from_city, to_city, tenure (tenant|owner), old_tenure (tenant|owner|parents), old_address, new_address, kids (yes|no), car (yes|no), gas (yes|no|unknown), employed (yes|no); new-business: type (patur|murshe|unsure), employee_too (yes|no), hire (yes|no), premises (home|rented), license (no|yes|unknown), age_band (under21|21-60|over60); new-job: other_income (second|earlier|no), had_pension (yes|no|unknown), employer_name; pregnancy: work (employee|self|none), tenure (lt6|6to12|12plus), employer_name, leave_start (YYYY-MM-DD), risk (yes|no); rent-home: lease_end (YYYY-MM-DD), option (yes|no), broker (yes|no), from_city, to_city, old_tenure (tenant|owner|parents), old_address, new_address; reserve-duty: service_start (YYYY-MM-DD), long (yes|no), work (employee|self|both|student|none), student (yes|no), combat (yes|no), employer_name, dismissed (no|yes), arnona_payer (yes|no), city, address; retirement: sex (m|f), age_67 (YYYY-MM-DD), work_after (no|yes|part), work_pension (yes|no), payers (one|more), low_income (yes|no|unknown), city, address, employer_name; school-start: stage (daycare|gan|first|other), city, moved (yes|no), move_date (YYYY-MM-DD), new_address, change_school (yes|no), after_school (yes|maybe|no).

as_of.description: Which steps are "for today" (default: today in Israel)

date.description: The event date (birth date, wedding, last day at work, first day at a new job, release or end of reserve service, date of death, moving or key-handover day, purchase date, the date of reaching retirement age, the day the business starts or stops, aliyah date, expected due date for a pregnancy). Past or future.

event.description: The life event, as an id or in words (Hebrew or English). Ids: aliyah, army-release, birth, buy-home, car, close-business, death, divorce, elderly-parent, first-employee, job-loss, marriage, moving, new-business, new-job, pregnancy, rent-home, reserve-duty, retirement, school-start.

for_whom.description: other = the plan is prepared by a family member for another person (labelled as such; the plan is information only and nothing is sent)

lang.description: Language of the summary text: he (default) or en. Files stay in Hebrew (official forms and Israeli letters).

reminder_days_before.description: Calendar alarm this many days before each deadline (0 = none, default 3)

subject_name.description: First name of the person the plan is for, when for_whom = other
